zh-CN.title: 需要观察的工作环境条件
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“分析在前，感受在后”这条自我感知线索。它不能决定适合什么岗位，只提示你核对哪些环境条件会影响沟通负荷、边界和恢复。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把抽象结果变成入职前或工作中的核对问题。
zh-CN.cost: 把环境偏好当成岗位匹配，会忽略具体职责、组织文化、管理者和生活阶段。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：核对压力升高时是否允许暂停、求助或交接。
zh-CN.micro_script: 这个环境允许人在压力升高时暂停、求助或交接吗？
zh-CN.reflection_question: 反馈是否具体、冲突能否暂停、边界是否被尊重、恢复是否可安排？
zh-CN.reflection_prompt: 记录一个实际环境、可观察证据和仍需追问的问题。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这些是待验证的环境条件，不是岗位匹配、录用或绩效预测。
zh-CN.why_this_matters: 把职业判断改成对真实工作条件的核对。
zh-CN.tiny_experiment: 选择一个真实团队，用公开规则或实际经历回答这一个环境问题。
zh-CN.result_page_depth: 用于核对工作条件，不用于岗位匹配或绩效预测。

zh-CN.title: 冲突：缩小问题，必要时暂停
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“温和连接，回避张力”这条自我感知线索。冲突升温时，建议验证：你是否能区分当前争议、旧账和安全风险，而不是一次处理全部问题。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是看见冲突中真正需要处理的那一小块，而不是证明谁是对的人。
zh-CN.cost: 问题越堆越多时，解释、防御或退让都可能取代实际解决。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：把争议缩小到当前一个可处理的问题；不安全时停止对话。
zh-CN.micro_script: 我们先只谈这一件事；如果现在不能安全地谈，我会先暂停。
zh-CN.reflection_question: 当前必须处理的一个问题是什么？此刻是否具备安全、平等的对话条件？
zh-CN.reflection_prompt: 记录当前争议、可暂停的界线和一个安全下一步。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 有威胁、控制、暴力或明显权力差时，暂停不是失败，安全优先。
zh-CN.why_this_matters: 把冲突缩小到一个问题，同时保留暂停权。
zh-CN.tiny_experiment: 下一次分歧出现时，先写下一句对当前问题的描述，不追加旧账。
zh-CN.result_page_depth: 用于冲突复盘，不用于预测你会如何处理分歧。
zh-CN.context: 意见分歧、语气升高、彼此防御，或问题迟迟无法推进时。

en.title: Conflict: narrow the issue and pause when needed
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “Warm connection, tension avoidance.” As conflict rises, check whether you can separate the current dispute, older grievances, and safety concerns instead of solving everything at once.
en.strength: The useful possibility is identifying the small part that needs handling now, rather than proving who is right.
en.cost: When issues pile up, explanation, defense, or concession can replace actual problem-solving.
en.better_move: Do one thing: narrow the dispute to one workable issue; stop the conversation if it is unsafe.
en.micro_script: Let’s discuss only this issue; if we cannot do that safely now, I am going to pause.
en.reflection_question: What is the one issue that must be handled now, and are the conditions safe and sufficiently equal?
en.reflection_prompt: Record the current issue, the pause boundary, and one safe next step.
en.do_not_overread: With threat, coercion, violence, or a marked power gap, pausing is appropriate and safety comes first.
en.why_this_matters: Narrows conflict to one issue while preserving the option to pause.
en.tiny_experiment: At the next disagreement, write one sentence describing the current issue without adding older grievances.
en.result_page_depth: For conflict review, not for predicting how you will handle disagreement.
en.context: When disagreement, sharper tone, mutual defensiveness, or stalled problem-solving appears.

zh-CN.title: 反馈：把评价落到具体行为
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“分析在前，感受在后”这条自我感知线索。收到反馈时，建议验证：你能否把任务信息与对人格的评价分开，再选择回应。

zh-CN.reflection_prompt: 记录具体行为、实际影响和你要追问的一点。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 若反馈含羞辱、威胁或明显权力压迫，先确保安全并寻求支持。
zh-CN.why_this_matters: 把笼统评价变成一次可核对的行为讨论。

en.why_this_matters: Turns a broad evaluation into one behavior discussion you can verify.

en.result_page_depth: For feedback review, not for inferring others’ evaluations or your ability.
en.context: When someone identifies a problem, requests a change, or evaluates your work or communication.

en.strength: The useful possibility is turning a vague evaluation into discussable facts; verify it against actual feedback exchanges.
en.cost: If tone becomes the whole message, or task criticism becomes a character judgment, the response can miss the issue.
en.better_move: Do one thing: ask for one specific behavior and its impact.
en.micro_script: Can you name one specific behavior and the impact it had?
en.reflection_question: Which behavior did the other person name, and what judgment did you hear in it?
en.reflection_prompt: Record the specific behavior, actual impact, and one point to clarify.
en.do_not_overread: If feedback includes humiliation, threat, or coercive power, prioritize safety and support.
en.why_this_matters: Turns a broad evaluation into one behavior discussion you can verify.
en.tiny_experiment: At the next feedback moment, record only the named behavior and impact before deciding how to respond.
en.result_page_depth: For feedback review, not for inferring others’ evaluations or your ability.
en.context: When someone identifies a problem, requests a change, or evaluates your work or communication.

zh-CN.title: 反馈：把评价落到具体行为
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“基础线索仍在建立”这条自我感知线索。收到反馈时，建议验证：你能否把任务信息与对人格的评价分开，再选择回应。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把模糊评价还原成可讨论的事实；是否做得到，需要看真实反馈记录。
zh-CN.cost: 若把语气当成全部信息，或把任务评价听成人格否定，回应可能偏离问题。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：请对方指出一项具体行为及其影响。
zh-CN.micro_script: 你能指出一个具体行为，以及它造成的影响吗？
zh-CN.reflection_question: 对方说的是哪项行为？你当时把它理解成了什么评价？
zh-CN.reflection_prompt: 记录具体行为、实际影响和你要追问的一点。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 若反馈含羞辱、威胁或明显权力压迫，先确保安全并寻求支持。
zh-CN.why_this_matters: 把笼统评价变成一次可核对的行为讨论。
zh-CN.tiny_experiment: 下一次收到反馈，只记录对方指出的行为和影响，再决定是否回应。
zh-CN.result_page_depth: 用于反馈复盘，不用于推断对方评价或你的能力。
zh-CN.context: 别人指出问题、要求修改，或评价你的成果与沟通时。

zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“敏感度高，吸收感偏强”这条自我感知线索。面对他人的情绪或请求时，建议验证：你能否既承认对方感受，也如实说明自己能做与不能做的范围。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把关心与无限责任分开，让善意有清楚的边界。
zh-CN.cost: 只表达理解却不说明范围，容易让临时帮助变成长期义务。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：用一句话同时说出理解，以及能做和不能做的范围。
zh-CN.micro_script: 我听见这件事让你很难受；我能做的是……，不能做的是……。
zh-CN.reflection_question: 你真心愿意承担哪一部分？哪一部分超出了时间、责任或安全边界？
zh-CN.reflection_prompt: 记录你理解的感受、能做的事和不能做的事。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 边界不能替代安全计划；控制、威胁或暴力情境应优先寻求现实支持。
zh-CN.why_this_matters: 把关心和承担分开，形成可表达的边界。
zh-CN.tiny_experiment: 下一次答应请求前，先写下自己能承担的范围，再开口回应。
zh-CN.result_page_depth: 用于边界复盘，不用于判断关系质量。
zh-CN.context: 别人期待你理解、帮忙、让步，或继续承接情绪时。

en.title: Relationship boundaries: acknowledge and define the limit
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “High sensitivity, stronger absorption.” When another person brings a strong feeling or request, check whether you can acknowledge it while stating what you can and cannot take on.
en.strength: The useful possibility is separating care from unlimited responsibility so that support has a clear boundary.
en.cost: Expressing understanding without defining a limit can turn temporary help into an open-ended obligation.
en.better_move: Do one thing: use one sentence to acknowledge the feeling and state what is and is not within your limit.
en.micro_script: I hear that this is painful; what I can do is …, and what I cannot do is ….
en.reflection_question: What are you genuinely willing to carry, and what exceeds your time, responsibility, or safety limit?
en.reflection_prompt: Record the feeling you understand, what you can do, and what you cannot do.
en.do_not_overread: A boundary is not a safety plan; coercion, threat, or violence calls for real-world support.
en.why_this_matters: Separates care from responsibility and makes the boundary speakable.
en.tiny_experiment: Before answering the next request, write down the part you can realistically take on.
en.result_page_depth: For boundary review, not for judging relationship quality.
en.context: When someone expects understanding, help, concession, or continued emotional availability.

zh-CN.title: 团队协作：把气氛翻译成分工
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“分析在前，感受在后”这条自我感知线索。团队协作中，建议验证：你是否会在任务之外默默承担协调情绪和补位的工作。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是注意到任务与关系同时在发生，再把隐性负担说清楚。
zh-CN.cost: 角色不清时，最愿意协调的人容易长期承担没有被命名的责任。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：把当前困扰改写成角色、负责人和截止时间。
zh-CN.micro_script: 这件事由谁负责、何时完成，遇到阻碍由谁决定？
zh-CN.reflection_question: 你正在完成自己的职责，还是在替团队承担未命名的协调工作？
zh-CN.reflection_prompt: 记录负责人、截止时间和遇阻时的决定者。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是协作观察，不是对团队成员或你本人能力的判定。
zh-CN.why_this_matters: 把团队气氛转成可检查的角色与流程。
zh-CN.tiny_experiment: 在下一次协作前，写下负责人、决定人和截止时间。
zh-CN.result_page_depth: 用于协作复盘，不用于判断团队或个人表现。
zh-CN.context: 多人协作、目标不清、责任交叉或节奏不一致时。

en.title: Team collaboration: translate atmosphere into roles
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “Analysis first, feeling second.” In teamwork, check whether you quietly take on emotional coordination or gap-filling beyond the task itself.
en.strength: The useful possibility is noticing task and relationship demands together, then making hidden work explicit.
